name: tracebird
description: Connect your Tracebird workspace (sign in with OAuth) and get skills for performance reviews, cutting wasted spend, building automations, split tests, tracking setup and reports.

interface.longDescription: Connect your Tracebird workspace with one sign-in and run it from your agent: review Facebook and Google Ads performance with attributed and front-end/back-end revenue, cut wasted spend, build automation rules, run landing-page split tests, set up tracking and conversions, and create reports. Every action Tracebird's app offers is available, with the same permissions.
defaultPrompt: Review my ad performance for the last 7 days
Find ads that are wasting spend
Build an automation rule to pause losing ads
